title: labctl / phase configuration
description: Configuration schema for labctl (phase) — a CLI tool for managing Proxmox VE virtual machines

naming.description: Naming conventions for VMs and resources. Names are auto-validated against these rules

pattern.description: Regex pattern that all VM and service names must match (alphanumeric, lowercase, hyphens only)

env_separator.description: Separator between env, service, and instance in VM names

networks.description: Network alias definitions. Each alias maps to one or more CIDR ranges. Aliases are used in firewall rules (--from <alias>) and for auto-detecting the best IP for SSH connections

templates.description: Proxmox template VM conventions. Defines how templates are named and what resource sizes are available

separator.description: Separator between prefix, size, and OS in template names

sizes.description: Available VM resource sizes. Validates --size against these definitions

bootstrap.description: Bootstrap script configuration. Scripts are uploaded to the VM via QEMU Guest Agent and executed with sudo. Per-OS overrides take precedence for the matching OS

directory.description: Base directory containing bootstrap scripts. Used as root for relative paths in os_overrides

os_overrides.description: Per-OS bootstrap script paths. Keys match --os values. Paths are relative to bootstrap.directory

additionalProperties.description: Path to the OS-specific script (relative to bootstrap.directory)

agent.description: Whether the QEMU Guest Agent should be enabled by default on new VMs

ssh_keys.description: SSH public keys injected into every new VM's cloud-init, merged with (and deduped against) keys inherited from the template. Each entry is either a path to a .pub file or a literal public-key string.

items.description: Path to a .pub file (e.g. /root/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub) or a literal 'ssh-... ' key string

confirm_destructive.description: Require explicit confirmation before destructive operations (destroy, reset)
